mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with clear skies near Verona Area High School. The air quality index is 52, which is moderate. We have a full moon tonight, and the ISS will be visible from over Cross Plains toward the Madison area starting at 3:27 AM for two minutes.

City Hall is highlighting several important initiatives. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month to address food insecurity for 1 in 8 residents, and he has also declared September as Suicide Prevention Month. Additionally, today is Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to honor our local safety guardians.

There is plenty to do this weekend. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon kicks off at the high school, and the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a Girls Try Hockey event.
On August 23, the Verona Police Department cited a 17-year-old for absolute sobriety and an 18-year-old for underage drinking.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM.
